def find_integer_k(a, b):
    # Calculate the midpoint between A and B
    k = (a + b) // 2
    
    # Check if K satisfies the condition |A - K| = |B - K|
    if abs(a - k) == abs(b - k):
        return k
    else:
        return "IMPOSSIBLE"

def main():
